segments.name: Sample Management Solutions
segments.description: Sells sample storage, automation and consumables products and manages sample inventories.
segments.evidence: Sample Management Solutions Within our Sample Management Solutions segment, we operate as a single business unit offering end-to-end sample management products and services, including SRS and Core Products (Automated Stores, Cryogenic Systems, Automated Sample Tube, Consumables and Instruments and Controlled Rate Thawing Devices).

segments.name: Multiomics
segments.description: Provides genomics, proteomics and cellular analysis services and products to researchers.
segments.evidence: This strategic action is intended to simplify our portfolio and allow management to focus on driving revenue growth and profitability in our core Sample Management Solutions and Multiomics segments.

revenueModel.text: Life science researchers and hospitals buy its sample management products and multiomics services.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer enhanced on-site and off-site management of biological sample inventories and integration solutions to our customers for their increasingly distributed workflows.

changes.text: Announced in the first quarter of fiscal 2025 that it is pursuing a sale of B Medical Systems.
changes.evidence: During the first quarter of fiscal year 2025, we announced that we are pursuing a sale of our B Medical Systems business, a manufacturer and global distributor of medical refrigeration devices based in Luxembourg.
